H1.claim: Control: our simulator reproduces the Stanford design's 97% solar reflectance within 2 points

H2.claim: A 5-layer TiO2/SiO2 stack reaches 55 W/m2: TiO2's high index makes a strong solar mirror

H3.claim: A 5-layer Al2O3/SiO2 stack reaches 55 W/m2: Al2O3 adds emission at 11-13 um

H4.claim: 4 layers of Si3N4/SiO2 on Ag reach 55 W/m2: Si3N4 emits at 10-12 um and SiO2 near 9 um, with little solar absorption
